{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
print(sales.dtypes)
print(sales.head())

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders from loyal customers
loyal_completed = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers: {mean_revenue}')"}
